Package hadur2.core.melee

Class MeleeWaves

java.lang.Object
hadur2.core.melee.MeleeWaves
public final class MeleeWaves extends Object
Targeting waves on every gun-heat cycle (MGUN-4): whenever the gun comes off cooldown, and every IDLE_INTERVAL ticks while it sits cool without firing, a wave goes out at every opponent in sight carrying the angle the field gun would aim at it. When a wave reaches its opponent it scores a virtual hit if the opponent is within its angular width of that aim, so the bench can read the gun's hit rate on every opponent, fired at or not.
